description: This header file defines interfaces and inline functions related to the Ralink RT3052 Ethernet switch in the Linux kernel. It includes function prototypes, conditional compilation directives, and license information.

methods.name: int __init mtk_switch_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the MediaTek switch if CONFIG_NET_RALINK_ESW_RT3052 is enabled.

methods.name: void mtk_switch_exit(void)
methods.description: Cleans up the MediaTek switch if CONFIG_NET_RALINK_ESW_RT3052 is enabled.

methods.name: rt3050_esw_init
methods.description: Initializes the RT3050 Ethernet switch with the provided private data.

methods.name: rt3050_esw_has_carrier
methods.description: Checks if the RT3050 Ethernet switch has carrier status with the provided private data.
